description: Calculate the d-band center of bulk Pd (FCC, Fm-3m) from projected density of states.
user_prompt: Calculate the d-band center of bulk palladium Pd (FCC, Fm-3m). Extract the d-band center (in eV relative to the Fermi level) from the Pd d-orbital projected DOS and report the final d-band center value.

references: Yu, Degradations and Improvements in PEM Fuel Cell Materials: A Computational Study, Caltech Ph.D. thesis (2012).
method.modeling: Use bulk FCC Pd and project the DOS on an equivalent Pd atom in the primitive cell.
method.rationale: Yu reports the bulk Pd d-sum band center from a three-dimensional crystal calculation as 2.30 eV below E_F; the benchmark value is therefore written as -2.30 eV. This is the bulk Pd d-orbital projection requested by the prompt, not a Pd(111) surface d-band center. Golio et al. summarize literature DFT Pd d-band centers spanning roughly -2.64 to -2.02 eV, so the target is within the expected projection/integration spread. The 0.4 eV absolute tolerance covers smearing choice, k-point convergence, PAW projection, and DOS integration-window differences.
